sources.snippet: nomic-embed-text-v2-moe nomic-embed-text-v2-moe is a state-of-the-art multilingual text embedding model built on a Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture. As the first general-purpose MoE text embedding model, it delivers exceptional multilingual retrieval performance while maintaining efficiency through sparse activation.

sources.snippet: Nomic Embed Text v2 MoE is the first general-purpose Mixture-of-Experts text embedding model, using 8 experts with top-2 routing to deliver 475M total parameters but only 305M active at inference. Trained on 1.6B high-quality pairs with consistency filtering, it achieves state-of-the-art performance on both BEIR and MIRACL benchmarks while remaining competitive with models twice its size.
